patthana17.2:1.1: abyākataṃ vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana17.2:3.1: kusalaṃ vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, kusalaṃ vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, kusalaṃ vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo ca na akusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā tīṇi.
patthana17.2:4.1: akusalaṃ vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, akusalaṃ vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, akusalaṃ vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo ca na akusalo na vipāka dhammadhammo ca dhammo uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana17.2:6.1: abyākataṃ neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, abyākataṃ neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. abyākataṃ neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo ca na akusalo na neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
